en_title: Sony Announces Indefinite Delay for PlayStation's Pulse Elevate Wireless Speakers Days Before Launch
cn_title: 索尼宣布无限期推迟PlayStation Pulse Elevate无线扬声器发售，距离上市仅剩数日
opus_summary: 索尼宣布，由于近期发现生产问题，PlayStation Pulse Elevate无线扬声器将无限期推迟发售，新的发售日期尚未公布。该产品原定于2026年11月12日全球发售，售价为219.99美元(约合人民币1470元)，可与PS5、PC、Mac及PlayStation Portal配对。

paragraphs.en: Sony has announced an indefinite delay for PlayStation's Pulse Elevate wireless speakers just days before their global launch.
paragraphs.cn: 索尼宣布无限期推迟PlayStation Pulse Elevate无线扬声器的发售，而距离其全球上市仅剩数日。

paragraphs.en: The tech company announced the last-minute schedule change in a November 6, 2026, update to an existing PlayStation.Blog post . The message cites a recently identified "production issue" that must be attended to, with no new release date shared.
paragraphs.cn: 这家科技公司于2026年11月6日更新了PlayStation.Blog上的一篇现有博文，宣布了这一临时日程变动。该消息称，近期发现了一个必须处理的「生产问题」，但没有公布新的发售日期。

paragraphs.en: "As part of our ongoing quality testing of Pulse Elevate speakers, we have identified a production issue with the product and have made the decision to delay the launch," Sony's announcement said. "The additional time will allow us to ensure the product will deliver the experience we intended for our players. We apologize for the delay and appreciate your patience and understanding. We look forward to bringing Pulse Elevate to players soon."
paragraphs.cn: 索尼在公告中表示：「在对Pulse Elevate扬声器持续进行质量测试的过程中，我们发现了该产品的一个生产问题，因此决定推迟发售。额外的时间将使我们能够确保产品为玩家带来我们预期的体验。我们对延期表示歉意，并感谢大家的耐心与理解。我们期待尽快将Pulse Elevate带给玩家。」

paragraphs.en: Scroll the tiniest bit further down, and you'll see that Sony had set the Pulse Elevate speakers to launch globally November 12 – just six days out from when the delay update was published. Whatever problem its team encountered must have been pretty significant, but without a new release date or additional information, it's unclear if we'll learn what happened.
paragraphs.cn: 稍微往下看一点，就会发现索尼原本计划于11月12日在全球推出Pulse Elevate扬声器，距离延期公告发布仅有六天。无论其团队遇到了什么问题，想必都相当严重，但由于没有新的发售日期或更多信息，我们是否能够了解发生了什么还不清楚。

paragraphs.en: Sony announced its new PlayStation-branded, $219.99 speakers in September of last year as the latest entry in its collection of Pulse audio accessories, which includes earbuds and headphones. They were said to be available in both Midnight Black and White, with both boasting a built-in microphone with "AI-enhanced noise rejection." The speakers are also able to be paired with PlayStation 5, PC, Mac, and even PlayStation Portal devices.
paragraphs.cn: 索尼于去年9月公布了这款售价219.99美元的全新PlayStation品牌扬声器，将其作为Pulse音频配件系列的最新成员；该系列还包括耳塞和耳机。据称，扬声器将提供午夜黑和白色两种配色，两种配色均配备带有「AI增强噪声抑制」功能的内置麦克风。这款扬声器还可以与PS5、PC、Mac，甚至PlayStation Portal设备配对。

paragraphs.en: "Pulse Elevate builds upon the immersive next-level gaming audio experience we introduced to players with Pulse Elite wireless headset and Pulse Explore wireless earbuds, combining powerful technologies like planar magnetic drivers and PlayStation Link into new form factors for players to experience with their favorite games," Sony said at the time of the announcement.
paragraphs.cn: 索尼在公布时表示：「Pulse Elevate以我们通过Pulse Elite无线耳机和Pulse Explore无线耳塞带给玩家的沉浸式次世代游戏音频体验为基础，将平面磁性驱动单元和PlayStation Link等强大技术融入新的产品形态，让玩家在喜爱的游戏中体验。」

paragraphs.en: How many units were manufactured ahead of the delay, or how the new issue may impact these existing speakers, was not made immediately clear. IGN took a closer look at all of the new PlayStation hardware, Pulse Elevate wireless speakers included, back in June. We came away looking forward to how the tech might work in practice, calling its noise rejection system "seriously impressive stuff."
paragraphs.cn: 延期之前生产了多少台扬声器，以及新发现的问题可能如何影响这些现有产品，目前尚不清楚。IGN早在6月就详细体验了所有全新的PlayStation硬件，包括Pulse Elevate无线扬声器。体验过后，我们期待看到这项技术在实际使用中的表现，并称其噪声抑制系统「确实令人印象深刻」。
